name: NMNH Summer High School Internship Program (YES! Program)
org: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History

offerings.summary: A paid eight-week summer internship at the Natural History Museum where high schoolers work with museum departments on science and non-science projects.

loc.venue: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History

grades.raw: Applicants must be currently enrolled high school students (grades 9 - 12)

age.raw: between the ages of 15 and 18 at the start of the internship program

residency.raw: All interns must be located within the D.C., Maryland, or Virginia area, within commuting distance of the National Museum of Natural History for the full duration of the internship program.

opens.raw: The application will launch on February 16th

deadlines.raw: the deadline to apply is: Friday, March 20th, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. (ET)

issues: Summer 2027 cycle not yet announced on this page

evidence.quote: Applicants must be currently enrolled high school students (grades 9 - 12) between the ages of 15 and 18 at the start of the internship program. All interns must be located within the D.C., Maryland, or Virginia area, within commuting distance of the National Museum of Natural History for the full duration of the internship program.
The application will launch on February 16th and the deadline to apply is: Friday, March 20th, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. (ET)
